morphology.pattern_note: di-构成被动式，与词根连写；不表示过去时。词根首音d保留，常见读音中词根音节末的k实现为[ʔ]。输入包把didakwa判为词根，应修正为dakwa。[DBP：dakwa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=dakwa)

senses.zh_definition: 被向法院提出控告或起诉；被正式指控涉嫌某项违法行为。
senses.en_definition: To be charged with an offence or prosecuted in court.
senses.ms_definition: Dikemukakan ke mahkamah untuk menghadapi tuduhan atau tuntutan.
senses.nuances: 在法庭报道中通常表示“被起诉”，不等于被捕、被判有罪或被判刑。是否已经发生须看telah、akan等时间或体貌标记。[DBP：dakwa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=dakwa)

collocations.en: be charged on a count of

senses.zh_definition: 被声称、被指称处于某种情况或实施某种行为；相关说法尚不必然获得证实。
senses.en_definition: To be alleged or claimed to be the case or to have done something.
senses.ms_definition: Dikatakan atau dinyatakan oleh sesuatu pihak sebagai benar, tanpa semestinya telah dibuktikan.
senses.nuances: 不限于刑事事件，也可修饰产品、文件或其他事物。通常相当于“据称、被指”，不能单凭didakwa判断是否已经启动法院程序。[DBP：dakwa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=dakwa)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Seorang pengurus syarikat didakwa di mahkamah atas pertuduhan pecah amanah, namun belum disabitkan kesalahan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 一名公司经理因涉嫌刑事失信被控上法庭，但尚未被判有罪。
dual_scenarios.en: A company manager has been charged in court with criminal breach of trust but has not been convicted.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dia dah didakwa kat mahkamah ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah dia sudah didakwa di mahkamah?
dual_scenarios.zh: 他已经被控上法庭了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Has he been charged in court yet?
spoken_features: 句末ke构成口语是非问句。
didakwa保留完整被动前缀，口语中也可直接使用。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dia dah didakwa kat mahkamah ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah dia sudah didakwa di mahkamah?
messages.zh: 他已经被控上法庭了吗？
messages.en: Has he been charged in court yet?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, tapi belum tentu bersalah. Kita tunggu keputusan dulu lah.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah didakwa, tetapi belum dipastikan bersalah. Kita tunggu keputusan mahkamah terlebih dahulu.
messages.zh: 已经被起诉了，不过还没确定有罪，先等法院判决吧。
messages.en: Yes, but that doesn't mean he's guilty. Let's wait for the court's decision.

etymology.historical_story: Didakwa is built from dakwa and the Malay passive prefix di-. The root belongs to a family linking accusations, courtroom proceedings, and assertions of truth. That connection explains why a news report can use didakwa for a formal charge in one sentence and for an unverified allegation in another. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=dakwa)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: di-先记“被”，dakwa记“控告或声称”：didakwa就是“被控／被指”，还没走到“定罪”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 涉及真实人物时，应准确区分“被指称”“被起诉”和“被判有罪”，保持中性措辞。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 常见于新闻、调查和法律语境。一般闲聊中不要把传言直接说成事实；需要时说明是谁提出该说法，以及是否已获证实。
